nodes.label: Graph Query / Path / Explain Traversal
nodes.rationale: BFS for broad 'what is X connected to' context, DFS for tracing a specific dependency chain; answers must use only what the graph contains, citing source_location, to avoid hallucinated edges.

nodes.label: Save-Result Feedback Loop
nodes.rationale: Each query answer is saved back into the graph so the next --update extracts the Q&A as a node, improving future queries.
